description: This file defines the VertexBase class, which manages authentication, URL construction, and API interactions for Google Cloud Vertex AI and related Google AI Studio models. It handles credential loading, token refreshing, URL generation for different models and endpoints, and supports both synchronous and asynchronous access token retrieval.

classes.name: VertexBase
classes.description: Represents a base class for interacting with Google Vertex AI, managing authentication, URL assembly, and API communication.

methods.description: Loads and parses credentials from various formats, supporting different Google auth configurations including external accounts and authorized users.

methods.description: Returns the default Google Cloud region for Vertex AI ('us-central1').
